name: icon
title: Icon
description: Naming an action in an icon-only button, or reinforcing a label beside it: add, close, search, replay.

files.content: <svg class="icon icon-lg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="4.75"/><path d="M13.5 13.5l-3.1-3.1"/></svg>

use_it_when: Naming an action in an icon-only button, or reinforcing a label beside it: add, close, search, replay.
Telling a state apart from its neighbours without colour alone: the warning triangle in an alert, the check in a done step.
use_something_else_when: The picture is the content: a photo, a logo, a map → an image, never an icon.
The meaning cannot be guessed from the drawing and there is room → a text label, with or without the icon.
